scope: canonical delivery lane classification, versioned scope authority, and post-merge completion proof for the One Loop delivery control-plane
symptom: Required preflight first failed closed because three repository-writer governance test paths were absent from the delivery lane classifier. After classifier and versioned-scope recovery, PR #1968 reached exact-head green and was squash-merged to main. Post-merge readback then exposed two control-plane regressions: Outcome Obligation Sweep assumed every protected merge SHA had a second Git parent, and Config-Wacht detected that Powerhouse Merged Branch Cleanup could fail without a concrete notification.
root_causes: The repository-writer contract tests were retained as governance verification, but config/brain-delivery-system.json had not yet declared their canonical owner lane.

The One Loop preflight uses config/powerhouse-one-loop-v1.json deliveryCandidate.expectedPaths as versioned branch-hygiene authority when versioned-manifest metadata is active. Adding a required canonical learning artifact without co-updating that authority produced SCOPE_CONTAMINATED.

Outcome Obligation Sweep derived the candidate for Production Release Readback exclusively with git rev-parse <production-sha>^2. GitHub squash merge creates a single-parent protected-main commit, so the exact production SHA 6ae18de754cb33044108d85ba704c965a5287b88 had no ^2 parent even though it was the verified squash merge of PR #1968.

Powerhouse Merged Branch Cleanup had explicit terminal failure exits and durable JSON evidence, but no GitHub issue update or ::error:: annotation. Config-Wacht therefore correctly rejected the workflow as an alarm that could turn red without telling operators why.
fixes: Classify only the three known repository-writer governance tests in the automation lane and preserve fail-closed behavior for unrelated future tests.
Keep every recovery/learning artifact explicitly admitted by the active versioned deliveryCandidate.expectedPaths authority.

For Production Release Readback, resolve squash-merge candidate identity from the unique merged PR whose merge_commit_sha exactly equals the production SHA and use its immutable head.sha; retain merge-parent resolution only as a fail-closed fallback for genuine multi-parent merge commits.
Give Outcome Obligation Sweep explicit pull-requests:read permission for that identity lookup without broadening write authority.

Emit a concrete ::error:: annotation from the merged-branch-cleanup EXIT trap whenever the cleanup exits non-zero, while retaining the existing durable evidence artifact and exact-head deletion safeguards.
prevention: CLASSIFIER_COCHANGE_REQUIRED: every new material governance or contract test must receive canonical lane classification in the same change that introduces or activates it.
FAIL_CLOSED_UNCLASSIFIED_PATHS: an unknown delivery path remains an error; never add a broad tests/** escape solely to make CI green.
VERSIONED_SCOPE_COCHANGE_REQUIRED: every material file added during recovery must be admitted by the exact active versioned scope authority in the same candidate.
SQUASH_MERGE_IDENTITY_IS_PR_BOUND: never infer a squash-merge candidate from a nonexistent Git parent. Bind production SHA to the exact merged PR and then to that PR's immutable head SHA.
MERGE_PARENT_IS_NOT_UNIVERSAL: ^2 is valid only after proving the production commit actually has at least two parents.
FAILURE_ALARMS_REQUIRE_REASON: every workflow containing a terminal failure path must emit a concrete GitHub issue update or ::error:: annotation in that same run.
EXACT_HEAD_ONLY: recovery evidence is valid only on the exact current candidate head; superseded runs remain historical diagnosis evidence.
terminal_acceptance: Set terminal status only after the recovery candidate is exact-head green in Required and BRAIN, protected merge succeeds, current main contains the recovery, Production Release Readback and Outcome Obligation Sweep both succeed on the resulting production identity, Config-Wacht is green, and the canonical completion/learning lineage confirms LIVE_PROVEN/FULFILLED.
